newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Solvay units A1 CP rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Solvay units A1 CP rating.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it affirmed the A1 commercial paper ratings of Solvay SA related entities Solvay Finance (America) Inc, Solvay Finance (Bermuda) Ltd and Solvay Finance (Cayman) Ltd.
All rated debt is guaranteed by Solvay SA, S&P said in a statement.
S&P said this followed the September 19 announcement that Solvay SA intended to sell all its worldwide animal health activities to American Home Products Corp.

"From a financial risk perspective, the deal will be broadly neutral over time as proceeds from the sale will be reinvested through selective acquisitions of either pharmaceutical product lines or companies," the rating agency said.

"From a business risk perspective, the strengthening of the higher margin human health business is positive as it gives the group valuable protection in the next cyclical downturn but...Solvay's overall performance remains closely tied to its leading businesses of alkalis, plastics, peroxygen and processing," S&P said.
